vulnerable_statements.reason: mtk_vdec_h264_get_ctrl_ptr() can fail and return an ERR_PTR (control not found / not set), but the return value is never checked with IS_ERR().
dec_params is dereferenced without validation; if the control lookup failed, this dereferences an error pointer, causing an invalid memory access / kernel oops.

suggested_fix: Fetch the decode params after the flush (bs == NULL) check and validate the result: `dec_params = mtk_vdec_h264_get_ctrl_ptr(...); if (IS_ERR(dec_params)) return PTR_ERR(dec_params);` before any dereference of dec_params.
